entries.title: Introducing AlertZero: Inbox zero for your alert queue
entries.description: AlertZero brings AI SOC automation to Elastic Security with four agents, one job each, so the queue stops setting your priorities. Nothing changes in your environment without your approval.

entries.title: Behind the tags: How Elastic SIEM grades 1,781 detection rules on noise, speed, and threat coverage
entries.description: This article explains how Elastic SIEM uses a monthly automated telemetry pipeline to score prebuilt detection rules across noise, performance, threat, and profile dimensions, helping security teams decide which rules to enable first.
